info.title: LEMS SCNMTC API
info.description:
# LEMS SCNMTC API

Backend for the Savior Church Nursing & Midwifery Training College portal.

## Using the API

- Base URL: `/api/v1`. Everything is JSON: send `Accept: application/json` (and `Content-Type: application/json` with a body).
- **Sign in** with `POST /auth/login`. Send the returned token on every other call: `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Tokens last 12 hours.
- Accounts are created by invitation only. There is no public registration.
- **Public ids** are 26-character ULIDs in lower case (for example `01j9z3k8q2v6x4n7m5r1t0w8yb`). Numeric database ids are never used.
- Lists are paginated: `?page=2&per_page=25` and answer `{data, links, meta}`.
- Times are ISO 8601 in UTC.

## Errors

Every error, from every endpoint, has the same body:

```json
{ "message": "The given data was invalid.", "errors": { "email": ["The email field is required."] }, "code": "validation_failed" }
```

`errors` is always an object (empty unless validation failed). Match on `code`, not on `message`.

| Status | code | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| 401 | `unauthenticated` | Missing, invalid or expired token |
| 401 | `invalid_credentials` | Wrong email or password |
| 403 | `forbidden` | Signed in but not allowed |
| 403 | `account_disabled` | The account was disabled |
| 404 | `not_found` | No such resource |
| 409 | `conflict`, `last_super_admin` | Conflicts with the current state |
| 422 | `validation_failed` | Field errors in `errors` |
| 422 | `invalid_token`, `cannot_disable_self` | Rule violation |
| 429 | `too_many_requests` | Slow down; see the `Retry-After` header |
| 500 | `server_error` | Our fault; nothing internal is leaked |
